# Turn a Square export into a Xero or QuickBooks journal

> Free Square transactions to journal converter: checks every payment, books gross sales, discounts, sales tax, tips, refunds and Square fees separately by month, totals each Deposit ID for your bank feed, and downloads a balanced journal for Xero, QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Desktop.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
